title: Chapter 128 God Of War And God Of Sword
content:
Chapter 128 God Of War And God Of Sword

At this time, somewhere in the deserted city.

The terrifying martial arts aura was not concealed at all, and it was opposite Huang Shou's sword intent.

"I am worthy of being the person I like to be the Lord of the City. This martial arts aura is even slightly better than Brother Huang's sword intent."

Seeing this scene, Gu Chen sighed.

Upon hearing this, Awei nodded in agreement.

Ouyang Yanqing, who was standing beside him, said in a deep voice: "Don't forget that guy had already mastered martial arts when he was in the Divine Emperor Realm, and now, he is just an improvement in his realm."

Hearing this, the two of them reacted, their expressions becoming even more serious.

Huang Shou was able to understand the sword intent in the Super God Realm because of the sword tower left by the City Lord, so that the sword intent could be understood and the sword intent was able to be understood and the Jiangbei was already in the Divine Emperor Realm.

As for whether they have received help from the city lord, they are not sure.

But that is the God of God Emperor realm.

This level is really too high.

In the void, Huang Shou felt the martial arts aura that faintly suppressed his sword intent, and his expression was also a little solemn.

It’s not that practicing swords is not as good as practicing martial arts, but that Jiang Bei’s understanding of martial arts is deeper than his understanding of swords.

After a moment of silence, Huang Shou shook his head and smiled.

My own path is still far.

In a mansion, a figure was sitting cross-legged on the ground, and the breath of the super-divine realm was constantly leaking.

After a while, Jiang Bei slowly breathed a sigh of relief and then opened his eyes.

Super God Realm.

However, he was a little dissatisfied with the speed.

Of course, in the past, if he could break through to the super god realm at this time, he might be so excited that he took off.

But since we came to the power of Huangcheng, everything has changed.

It is common to break through from the God Lord Realm to the God Emperor Realm in a few days.

boom!

Jiang Bei held his hands tightly, and the space in the room began to break.

His power has undergone earth-shaking changes at this moment.

"I don't know where my strength limit is now?"

After a moment of silence, Jiang Bei seemed to have thought of something, and then looked up at Huang Shou in the void.

Feeling Jiangbei's gaze, Huang Shou also looked over.

"Please ask?"

Jiang Bei smiled faintly.

Upon hearing this, Huang Shou nodded.

"Extreme honor."

Immediately, Jiangbei soared into the sky and came not far from Huang Shou.

Below, when Awei and others saw this scene, their expressions trembled.

If these two guys fight, how much noise will be.

And at this moment, a terrifying force suddenly surged out from the depths of the city lord's mansion, and instantly turned into a barrier to surround the two of them.

"this,,"

"It seems that there are strong people in the deserted city who don't even know about it."

The few people said with serious expressions.

But I think so, if a person like the city lord suddenly left Huangcheng, how could he have no backup plan?

In the void.

Jiangbei and Huang Shou laughed immediately when they saw this barrier.

Now, they can let go.

"Please."

Jiangbei spoke first.

Hearing this, Huang Shou didn't say much.

Buzz —

The sound of swords sounded and the battle was about to begin.

At the same time, more and more powerful people from the deserted city rushed here to watch this extraordinary battle.

This is a showdown between the God of Martial Arts and the God of Swords.

Almost never seen in tens of millions of years.

On the other hand, Yan Yan and the old man from the Hungu Star Domain finally arrived in front of the deserted city. At this moment, looking at the magnificent and sacred giant city in front of him, the two of them were extremely nervous.

After taking a deep breath, the two of them slowly walked to the city gate.

"This guy, I wonder if your city lord is here?"

Hunyue saw the young man guarding the city gate and asked quickly.

At this time, a young man from the Zhang family was guarding the city gate. When he saw Hunyue, the young man was stunned and then said indifferently: "I don't know this."

Seeing this, Hun Yue quickly took out a ring and stuffed it into the boy's hand. Then he smiled and said, "Brother, I'm here for the first time. I'm not familiar with the place,"

Hearing this, he looked at the ring in his hand again, and the young man frowned slightly.

Someone actually bribed me.

Will you like these things?

But out of physical instinct, he took a look.

The next moment, he was breathing heavily.

I have not had a very high status in the family, so I was sent to visit the door and collect tolls.

It is precisely because of this job that I am really not short of money.

However, the old man in front of him gave too much.

Who would think that they have too much money?

Looking at Hunyue again, he suddenly felt that the old man had become kind.

"Haha, old man, you are polite. If you want to meet our city lord, you can go to the wasteland guards in the city, and they will take you into the city lord's mansion."

Hearing the answer he wanted, the two of them hurriedly thanked and then stepped into the deserted city.

"this,,"

Seeing the scenery in the city, the two of them stood there again, as if they had never seen the world.

On the side, pedestrians did not forget to leave a look of contempt when passing by.

Where did the two local buns come from?

Seeing everyone's strange eyes, the two of them quickly put away their shocked expressions and then quickly walked towards the depths of the city.

Soon, the two of them successfully found a Huangwei.

"You two want to meet the city lord?"

Looking at the kind Hung Yue and Yan Yan in front of him, Huang Wei asked in confusion.

Hearing this, the two nodded repeatedly.

"I hope you can inform me."

After a moment of silence, the guard shook his head, "Lord City Lord, not everyone can see you, please go back."

It must be said that this guard was quite polite.

If it were a guard with a bad temper, he might have ridiculed him directly.

Look at what you look like, and you still want to see the Lord City Lord.

It's hard to say whether my leader will see you or not.

At the original place, Hun Yue wanted to say something, but Yan Yan directly stretched out his hand to stop him.

The next moment, a breath of the God Emperor realm slowly overflowed from his body.

The God Emperor realm!

Suddenly, the guard was stunned.

"Wait a moment, I will inform the leader."

The guard left this sentence and then hurriedly got up and left.

Since it is the God Emperor realm, it's easy to say.

Although the strength of the city is very strong now, the God Emperor realm will not be taken seriously, but that is the city, not him, and he, a small guard, can still tell the difference.

Looking at the anxious Huang Wei, Yan Yan smiled faintly, "Wouldn't it be better if it was done earlier."

On the side, Hun Yue smiled awkwardly, "I think it's better to keep a low profile."

Hearing this, Yan Yan shook his head.

"It's better to keep a low profile, otherwise it might backfire."

They don't understand the style of this Huangcheng. What if they show too weak and the other party looks down on them?

They haven't forgotten their purpose.

Of course, the probability of this is also very small.

In the City Lord's Mansion.

"Two God Emperors?"

A Wei frowned as he looked at the Huang Wei who came to report in front of him.

At this time, two strange God Emperors came from outside. What could it be?

After a moment of silence, A Wei turned his head and said, "Brother Gu, I have something to do, so I'll leave first."

On the side, Gu Chen was still concentrating on watching the battle between the two in the void. Hearing A Wei's words, Gu Chen nodded, "Okay, go."

Then A Wei left.
